# Temple Scroll Column 54 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 54 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**54:1** You shall not charge your brother interest: interest on silver, interest on food, interest on anything that is lent at interest.

**54:2** You may charge a foreigner interest, but you shall not charge your brother interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all your undertakings in the land that you are entering to possess.

**54:3** When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay in fulfilling it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin in you.

**54:4** But if you refrain from making a vow, there shall be no sin in you.

**54:5** What has gone forth from your lips you shall observe and do, just as you have voluntarily vowed to the LORD your God, what you promised with your mouth.

**54:6** When you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, as many as you wish, but you shall not put any in your container.

**54:7** When you enter your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck ears with your hand, but you shall not put a sickle to your neighbor's standing grain.

**54:8** When a man takes a wife and marries her, and she fails to find favor in his eyes because he has found in her something indecent, he shall write her a certificate of divorce, place it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

**54:9** And she departs from his house and goes and becomes the wife of another man.

**54:10** If the second husband comes to hate her and writes her a certificate of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her out of his house, or if the second husband who married her dies —

**54:11** then the first husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the LORD; and you shall not bring sin upon the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

**54:12** When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out with the army, nor shall any public duty be imposed on him; he shall be free at home for one year and shall bring joy to the wife he has taken.

**54:13** No one shall take a millstone or an upper millstone as a pledge, for he would be taking a life as a pledge.

**54:14** If a man is found kidnapping one of his brothers among the Israelites, and he enslaves him or sells him, that kidnapper shall die; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.

**54:15** Be careful concerning an outbreak of skin disease, to observe diligently all that the Levitical priests instruct you; as I have commanded them, so you shall be careful to do.

**54:16** Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way when you came out of Egypt.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 54 reworks Deuteronomy 23:19-24:9. "Certificate of divorce" for sefer keritut — the standard legal rendering. "Something indecent" for ervat davar. "Skin disease" for tsara'at following current scholarly consensus (not "leprosy"). "Kidnapping" makes explicit the meaning of "stealing a soul."*
